mechanism: Pyrazinamide causes hepatotoxicity and elevated uric acid levels, which may potentiate naltrexone's hepatic metabolism and complicate monitoring of therapeutic efficacy in patients with underlying liver disease or gout.
action: Monitor liver function tests regularly; assess for signs of hepatotoxicity; consider alternative tuberculosis regimen if significant LFT elevation occurs; evaluate naltrexone efficacy periodically during pyrazinamide therapy.
